purpose.title: What Get Phame does
purpose.description: Get Phame helps local businesses send personalized review-request emails from their own connected email account. It is built for business owners, photographers, cafés and restaurants, home-service teams, clinics and salons, agencies, and WooCommerce stores that want a simpler way to ask real customers for feedback.

steps.send: Send a personal request from your email
steps.reviews: Direct customers to your selected review platform

purpose.googleDescription: Google sign-in is used only to create and identify your Get Phame account. With your permission, Get Phame receives your name and email address. We do not request access to your Gmail messages, contacts, Google Drive files, or Google Calendar.
purpose.googleSendingNote: Review-request sending is configured separately inside the app using an email account you choose to connect.

faq.a1: Each request is sent through an email account you connect and uses the sender name, address, signature, and message you configure. Preview the message before sending and follow your provider's deliverability guidance.
faq.a6: Messages are sent through the email account you connect, so your provider's sending limits, domain reputation, SPF, DKIM, content, and recipient engagement can affect delivery. No service can guarantee inbox placement.
faq.a9: No. Get Phame provides provider-specific setup guidance for Gmail, Outlook, and other supported SMTP services. Custom SMTP connections require the server address, port, and credentials supplied by your provider.
faq.a2: Get Phame works with supported Gmail, Outlook, and SMTP connections, including Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Yahoo, Zoho, iCloud, and custom SMTP providers.
faq.a3: Yes. The free plan starts with 10 review requests, then provides 5 more every rolling 30 days, with no credit card required. Paid plans add higher-volume workflow features.
faq.q4: Can I import my customer list?
faq.a4: Yes. In Sources, upload a CSV or connect WooCommerce, confirm your permission basis, review valid and duplicate rows, and then import the contacts you approve. Importing contacts never sends a message.
faq.q5: Does Get Phame store my email password?
faq.a5: SMTP credentials are encrypted at rest and are used only for the sending connection you configure. Get Phame does not use those credentials to read your inbox.
faq.q6: Will my emails land in spam?
faq.q7: What happens to my customer list?
faq.a7: Customer details are used to support the review-request workflows you choose. Sources keeps imports owner-scoped, records consent metadata without duplicating contact PII in its audit history, and lets you review contacts before any send action.
faq.a8: Yes. Requests include an unsubscribe option, and an opted-out contact is excluded from future outreach through Get Phame.
faq.q9: Do I need technical skills to connect my email?
faq.q10: Which review platforms does it support?
faq.a10: Get Phame supports configurable review destinations and provides platform-aware guidance before sending. Some platforms, including Yelp, require a different compliance approach rather than a standard solicitation link.
faq.a11: Connect WooCommerce in Sources, fetch recent completed-order contacts into a review queue, confirm your permission basis, preview duplicates and rejected rows, and import only the contacts you approve. There is no background import and no automatic campaign.
faq.q12: What does unlimited mean on the Pro plan?
faq.a12: The paid plan does not apply a monthly Get Phame request quota. Each request is still sent individually through an account you connect, and your email provider's limits plus applicable consent and platform rules still apply.
